input-field.name: showServicesBanner
input-field.label: Show Shopware Services banner
Shopware-Services-Banner anzeigen
input-field.helpText: Renders the core Shopware Services dashboard banner above the widget board (same as the default admin dashboard).
Zeigt das Shopware-Services-Banner der Standard-Administration oberhalb des Widget-Boards an.

input-field.name: showExtensionSections
input-field.label: Show extension injection points
Erweiterungs-Einschübe anzeigen
input-field.helpText: Keeps the core dashboard slots sw-dashboard__before-content and sw-dashboard__after-content so other plugins can inject UI around the board.
Behält die Core-Dashboard-Slots sw-dashboard__before-content und sw-dashboard__after-content, damit andere Plugins UI um das Board herum einbinden können.
